heading: Everything Your Site Needs
subtext: One flat monthly price covers build, hosting, security, updates, and small content changes. No surprise invoices.
cardLead: This isn't a template you pay for and babysit. It's a done-for-you site that stays working year after year — and stays out of your way while you're on the job.
benefits: Complete trade-business website — services / trades, crew, licensed-and-insured trust signals, service area, contact
Estimate-request form that emails you directly
Search and AI engine optimization — structured for Google to read, ready for ChatGPT-style search engines
Managed hosting, SSL, daily backups, and uptime monitoring
Small content changes handled for you — crew updates, service-area changes, new trades, multi-crew rosters
Direct email support — no tickets, no call centers
note: Sites from $129/mo, billed annually — see the pricing page for the full tier breakdown. Business email is a $10/mo per-mailbox add-on. We'll confirm the right fit on the intro call.
